title: L11 / C07: genuine safeupdate disposable import proof
public_pr_body:
Adds a fresh-stack local runner and targeted PR/manual CI job with genuine pg-safeupdate from the disposable Supabase Postgres image. Its bootstrap administrator configures scoped preload without promoting importer/authenticated roles; fresh direct connections must prove on, unsafe UPDATE/DELETE/PLpgSQL refusal and qualified control. Existing and new credit/delivery RPC and actual SliQ CLI tests run; JSON gate refuses all skips/pending/empty/failures.

PASSED: targeted Actions run 41871020772, 25 tests across all three required files, zero skips/pending. Tested source db75ea2ec941f194b7e96f77b0e015267d201cf7 / actual PR merge 62af6ae1655e55a09fae81e4da611b4990ba10fa. Artifact 13344811572, SHA256 294f92b8a4a4a85b69d0141eec6699f71788df70df80044ffc8015aa6e083cc3. Final follow-up changes evidence text only; executable tree matches the passing source. Syntax, explicit changed-file lint and candidate typecheck also passed.

Covers normal credit/delivery import, invalid refusal, business-state/counter-preserving dry run, injected mid-write rollback, retry/idempotence, staged undo and other-company isolation. Path distinction remains explicit: credit/delivery notes use migration-085 import_company_data RPC engine; SliQ CLI uses import_legacy_tenant and has no credit/delivery writer/undo API. Actual final cutover route/independent approval remain separate.

Handover docs/handover/C07-SAFEUPDATE-IMPORT-PROOF.md preserves initial local image-store ENOSPC and three corrected CI setup failures, plus exact passing run/artifact. Safeupdate is available and active in CI; no library-install impossibility remains. Targeted proof only, not full release validation. Draft into pinned 9c3f5c6 review base; no source migration changes, main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
